gaps.summary: The synthetic GitHub Models harness and the real anilize task package conflict. Any future efficacy claim requires no-Soleaux control, historical Python baseline, and native treatment using one authenticated model/client.

Close current-source defects in request-schema validation, stale index refresh, edit rollback integrity, idempotency reservation, redaction coverage, transactional adopt/revert, truthful coverage gaps, SQL error semantics, LSP capability advertisement, and preview concurrency metadata.

Implement accounts, native mappings, sessions, turns, messages, content parts, memory claims/lifecycle, handoffs, runs, subagents, approvals, artifacts, materializations, conflicts, cursors, audit, tombstones, and retention.

Implement encrypted content-addressed artifacts, OS-keychain master keys, per-workspace key separation, short-lived attenuated capabilities, peer credentials, comprehensive redaction, policy, backup, repair, and recovery.

Complete the exact CLI/runbook, per-user daemon lifecycle, typed local IPC, JSON/dry-run behavior, install/service/doctor/CI/cache/index/integrate/handoff/backup/restore/export/repair/uninstall flows.

Implement and live-test Claude Code Agent SDK/SessionStore/hooks, Claude Desktop supported MCP/export-import boundaries, Codex generated app-server client, and OpenCode generated OpenAPI/SSE/plugin adapter with safe mode on unknown versions.

Implement memory proposal/validation/supersession/tombstones, session/history projection, same-platform resume/fork/archive, and signed cross-platform handoff packets carrying Git/code state, artifacts, exclusions, permissions, and lineage.

Implement durable command/run/approval/subagent orchestration with leases, idempotency, budgets, worktree isolation, capability attenuation, crash reconciliation, cancellation propagation, and result aggregation.

Complete Oxc extraction, Tree-sitter query packs/injections/incremental watcher corpus, LibCST write worker, mvdan shell semantics/sandbox, real LSP matrix, Turbo documented CLI/probes, Next Oxc static index plus capability-driven DevTools merge, scale and pathological-file behavior.

Complete cross-host rules/skills/agents compatibility compiler, guidance-versus-enforcement reporting, diff/backup/atomic apply/rollback, object/revision/origin/idempotency metadata, echo-loop prevention, and native load verification.
Add versioned parser/workspace/route/context/materializer/gateway provider interfaces, stable native-daemon SDKs, non-interactive CI mode, editor extension, and capability-gated webhook/SIEM export.
Add optional licensed/checksummed hybrid lexical-vector-graph search with sensitivity exclusions, incremental embedding, migrations, rebuild, and corruption recovery after core correctness.

Build the Tauri desktop, one Expo/React Native mobile app, onboarding, Context Inspector, sessions/runs/subagents, approvals, catalog/memory, diagnostics, pairing, device certificates, LAN, E2E relay, push, revocation, updates, backup/restore, and installer lifecycle.

Complete measured performance, fuzzing, cross-workspace and prompt-injection tests, external penetration/privacy/license/accessibility review, OS parity, signed SBOM/provenance, relay hardening, incident/rollback exercises, and enterprise gates after the local product.

Produce signed/notarized desktop and signed Windows packages, TestFlight/Play builds, staged design-partner/public rollout, support/privacy/compatibility materials, explicit production-claim decision, and GA verification only after all prior evidence gates.

Do not reintroduce agent-OS positioning, premature RC/GA claims, a production Node daemon, parallel SwiftUI/Compose product trees, standalone SSE as primary MCP transport, GPL parsers in core, direct vendor DB writes, false cross-platform native resume, or root-tool inflation beyond twelve.
